entries.name: SGB-7342
entries.stage: Phase 1 first participant dosed; registry status predates sponsor update
entries.summary: SanegeneBio reports that the first participant was dosed in January 2026 in a Chinese Phase 1 study of subcutaneous SGB-7342. The investigational GalNAc-conjugated siRNA targets INHBE messenger RNA; the registered study is a single-ascending-dose safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic study in adults with obesity or overweight.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for SGB-7342 or this formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: A Chinese Phase 1 study and sponsor pipeline listing do not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The ClinicalTrials.gov record was last updated before the sponsor's first-participant announcement and still displayed not yet recruiting when reviewed. Sponsor-described fat-mass and lean-mass observations are preclinical and are not presented as human efficacy, body-composition or muscle-function evidence. No human study results are posted.
